def: childbirth (parentage), i.e. (by implication) maternity (the performance of maternal duties)

occurrences.text: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
